objective: A readable cinematic midnight ocean, clouds and rain that retain a midnight mood
design: Dark indigo horizon with brighter overhead sky/reflection fill and broad off-frame soft key
Actual Moon direction and phase retained, with photographic lunar key strength raised from 0.006 to 0.12
Low-angle surface-normal fill reveals wave faces and keeps trough contrast
Night rain illumination follows the shared environment with a restrained scattering minimum
Existing exposure, tone mapping, star flux, celestial paths and day output preserved

verification.scope: Display luminance/readability gates plus native visual review. Synthetic coordinates, no network/windows/user-cache writes. Night stays cool, contrasted and visibly darker than day; scene lighting changes, not a postprocess black-level lift.

gpuValidation.fixture: Moonless hurricane at synthetic public coordinates
gpuValidation.comparisonPolicy: Daytime byte parity is evaluated only in matched production settings. Initial comparison of shader-instrumented output to uninstrumented baseline differed by relative HDR L2 0.000438; matched production day and day-storm HDR/display output are exact.

performance.scope: Sequential unprofiled ABBA on Apple M1, same 1280x800 internal target, 30 fps, 180 frames, first 60 excluded; live preview stopped and no concurrent rendering tests. Lighting changes intentionally. Command-buffer timings, not whole-system energy.

livePreview: Updated native app opened once, presented through full-screen to activate the drawable, visually verified with readable midnight waves/clouds/star field, then restored to normal windowed mode with real time and local weather.
scope: Art-directed photographic lighting, not measured nighttime irradiance. Display RGB luma statistics are readability proxies. Frame timings do not measure whole-system energy.
